notes.title: 🍺 Bartender update!
notes.notes:
The following issues have been fixed in the latest update:

Fixed the issue where purchased boosters would disappear. To make up for this inconvenience, we've also reduced booster prices by 50%.

Improved the shop interface.

Fixed a bug where cards could disappear when copying a deck.

Fixed a bug that occurred during the blacksmith’s metal-finding quest.

Added new visual effects to certain story events and the ending.

As promised, we’ve started adding content that was originally planned for paid DLC. A new quest involving the bartender has been added to the game. To start it, talk to the bartender and choose the "Player" dialogue option.

notes.title: Important Update!
notes.notes:
We are actively improving the game and fixing bugs.
Here’s what has been fixed and improved in the current update:

Tooltips now appear when hovering over a creature, showing its properties.

Chaos and Nature cards can now be upgraded.

Fixed the “Not enough mana” message — it no longer stays on screen indefinitely.

Fixed achievement localization issues.

Planned for this week:

A combat history log to let you review which cards your opponent played.

New bartender quest +1 sex scene.

Localization improvements.

User interface enhancements.

We also realize that we may have rushed the release a bit.
To make up for that, over the next 1–2 weeks we’ll be adding bonus quests featuring girls that were originally planned for paid DLC — completely free.
In total, just over 10 new sex scenes will be added.

Huge thanks for your support and feedback — it truly means a lot to us!
If you find a bug, press F1 to open the bug report window.
Please include a short description of what you think went wrong — screenshots and logs alone don’t always make the issue clear.

notes.title: HOT FIX!!!
notes.notes:
We carefully listen to what our players say, which is why we decided to make the game easier.
We've also made various minor improvements.

🛠️ Recent Updates:

Increased the reward for winning an arena challenge to 900 gold.

Added a new player ability: Epiphany — allows you to draw a card by spending mana.

Added a "Retry Battle" button — now you can restart any fight if you're unhappy with the drawn cards or heading toward a loss.

Improved Genie's animation.

Moved the airship closer to the dock.

Enhanced voice acting in sex scenes and combat.

🧠 Coming Soon:
